description: Choose whether this board is a freeform whiteboard ('draw', the default) or a kanban task board ('todo'). Mode is switchable WHENEVER the board is empty of real content: drawings (text/strokes/images) and tasks. Empty or seeded columns DON'T count (switching to 'draw' clears columns and lane titles), so a cleared board can be switched again, and you can flip draw<->todo freely until the first stroke/text/image or task lands. Setting 'todo' auto-seeds three starter columns (To do / In progress / Done). Returns `{ mode, columns }`. Use the task/column tools (`create_task`, `create_column`, …) once the board is in 'todo' mode.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.

template.description: Optional starter column template when mode is 'todo': 'kanban' (To do / In progress / Done, the default), 'sprint' (Backlog / Sprint / Review / Done), or 'bugs' (Triage / Confirmed / In progress / Fixed). Unknown/omitted falls back to 'kanban'.
